summary: Caloocan 3rd District representative with 12 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant bills are an electricity lifeline-rate expansion for minimum-wage earners and travel-tax abolition, plus a digital permit-verification measure. Evidence is limited to one dimension.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills; economic 0 reflects a subsidy bill against a tax-cut bill, not missing data.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Electricity lifeline-rate expansion for minimum-wage earners (-2, consumer subsidy) versus travel-tax abolition (+2, tax cut). Thin evidence.
